title: Proposal to Search for the CP Violating Electromagnetic Vacuum Angle at the Event Horizon Telescope
summary: We examine the possibility that evidence for a non-zero value of the CP violating $ \frac{e^2 }{32π^2}θ_{EM} \int d^4 x {\vec E}\cdot {\vec B}$ coupling might be extracted from Event Horizon Telescope observations of the black holes SgA* and M87*. The Fischler-Kundu\cite{FK} effect predicts a universal Hall current in the relaxation of charge falling onto the black hole horizon. We argue that this leads to a non-zero value of a certain CP-violating observable ${\cal C}$, defined below. The effect can be masked by parity violating plasma currents.
